name: function-test-examples
goal: A function is shown with the input and output its tests recorded, row by row, and never with a design image; plans stay notes, and what is not recorded says so

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: A function is shown with design surfaces and a legacy input and output block: its card asks for a thumbnail or says Design preview unavailable, its view has a Designs section, and a recorded result is drawn as Input, Actual output, where the reader also takes a top-level actual as output. Wanted: rows of input and observed output from recorded results only, an explicit gap otherwise, no design picture or image read for a function, plans as notes. Spec: specification/features/planned/function-test-examples.md.

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test; record the defect assertion and command.
steps.evidence: Frozen on f13f6c5 before product edits (frozen-tests.sha256). reports test/artifact-cases-view.test.ts: 4 failed, 2 controls passed. desktop test/function-examples.test.ts: 5 failed, 3 controls passed. planning test/function-plan-images.test.ts: 1 failed, 1 control passed. desktop tests/e2e/ui-function-examples.spec.ts on port 5813: 5 failed, the page control passed; pictures taken before the assertion in before/. test/compose-modes-cases.test.ts calls the real composeModes and passes: it is the recorded example, not a regression. Logs in red/.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Opus implemented input/output rows and function headless plans; precise fallback preserves them, wraps clipped tabs, registers shared ownership, and binds six function UI captures plus real invocation trace.

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: Frozen current/commit/image suppression regressions pass; 11 focused browser checks and 24 preview checks pass. Stamped desktop-renderer accepts34 captures; genuine composeModes scenario accepts3. Four malformed/fake matcher mutants fail, control passes. Root exact verification remains pending.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots; keep pending until proof passes.
